Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning public notification of local health conditions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public notification of local health conditions;adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 70.05 RCW; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By August 1, 2013, the department shall establish a temporarywork group of public health officials, health communication experts,and organizations representing health care providers. (2) By December 31, 2013, the temporary work group shall report tothe appropriate legislative committees its recommendations forimplementing best practices to communicate significant health risks tothe public, including special emphasis on vulnerable populations. (3) This section expires August 1, 2014.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each local board of health may adopt a community health alertnotification plan that establishes the method by which the local health p. 1 SHB 1139department, health district, or combined citycounty health departmentkeeps the public who reside in its jurisdiction informed of significanthealth risks to the public. (2) If a local board of health adopts a community health alertnotification plan, the plan must be made available to the public on theweb site of each local public health department, health district, orcombined citycounty health department.
